convert_transformer_checkpoint: convert a CogVideoX transformer checkpoint to diffusers format by renaming and remapping state dict keys
convert_vae_checkpoint: convert a CogVideoX VAE checkpoint to diffusers format by renaming keys and replacing up block indices
run_conversion_script: run the CLI script to convert CogVideoX transformer and VAE checkpoints to a diffusers pipeline
reassign_query_key_value_inplace: split a combined query_key_value tensor into separate to_q, to_k, and to_v tensors in the state dict
reassign_adaln_norm_inplace: split adaln modulation weights into separate norm1 and norm2 linear weight and bias tensors
